paper.title_en: Stability of Synthetic Timelike Ricci Bounds under $C^0$-Limits and Applications to Impulsive Gravitational Waves
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the stability of timelike Ricci curvature lower bounds under low-regularity limits of Lorentzian metrics. Specifically, we prove that the synthetic curvature-dimension condition $\mathsf{TCD}^e_p(K,N)$, which provides an optimal transport formulation of the Hawking-Penrose strong energy condition, is stable under locally uniform convergence of smooth Lorentzian metrics, provided a uniform global hyperbolicity assumption holds. As a consequence, smooth locally uniform limits of vacuum spacetimes satisfy the strong energy condition, even though curvature is not controlled a priori. As a main application, we study impulsive gravitational waves - spacetimes with Lipschitz continuous metrics - and show that large classes of such waves satisfy synthetic timelike Ricci curvature lower bounds. In the case of Minkowski background, we further establish synthetic upper Ricci curvature bounds. Our approach relies on constructing suitable smooth approximations with lower bounds on the timelike Ricci, and analyzing the limiting behavior via Lorentzian optimal transport. We also apply the aforementioned stability theorem to weak solutions of the Einstein equations arising from the nonlinear interaction of impulsive gravitational waves. These results yield new geometric insights into low-regularity solutions of the Einstein equations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究时间型Ricci曲率下界的稳定性及其在脉冲引力波中的应用，属于广义相对论基础领域，理论深度高，方法严谨，具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 时间型Ricci曲率下界在$C^0$极限下的稳定性及其在脉冲引力波中的应用
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在洛伦兹度量低正则性极限下时间型Ricci曲率下界的稳定性。具体地，我们证明了合成曲率-维度条件$\mathsf{TCD}^e_p(K,N)$（该条件提供了霍金-彭罗斯强能量条件的最优输运表述）在光滑洛伦兹度量的局部一致收敛下是稳定的，前提是满足一致的全局双曲性假设。因此，真空时空的光滑局部一致极限满足强能量条件，即使曲率没有先验控制。作为主要应用，我们研究了脉冲引力波——具有Lipschitz连续度量的时空——并表明这类波的大类满足合成时间型Ricci曲率下界。在闵可夫斯基背景的情况下，我们进一步建立了合成时间型Ricci曲率上界。我们的方法依赖于构造具有时间型Ricci下界的合适光滑近似，并通过洛伦兹最优输运分析极限行为。我们还将上述稳定性定理应用于由脉冲引力波非线性相互作用产生的爱因斯坦方程的弱解。这些结果为爱因斯坦方程的低正则性解提供了新的几何见解。
